$comment: Built-in harness smoke cases (see docs/04-agent-harness.md#harness-smoke-test). Each entry is a (harness_id, provider_id, model_id) triple resolved against the orchestrator DB at run time, so harnesses without a free-provider agent profile still get a live test. Every harness in packages/server/src/harnesses/index.ts must be covered by at least one profile or entry here.
